providers.quote: Every paid price column is headed "Paid Tier, per 1M tokens in USD". Gemini 2.5 Flash, Input price: "$0.30 (text / image / video)   $1.00 (audio)". Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite, Input price: "$0.25 (text / image / video)   $0.50 (audio)". Audio is tokenized at a fixed rate (https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/audio): "Tokens: 32 tokens per second of audio (1 minute = 1,920 tokens)".

excluded_models.reason: The pricing page has no row for the preview model (only the GA Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite), and models.dev's input_audio (0.5) differs from its input (0.25), so neither an explicit audio row nor a single unsplit input price supports the number.

declined.quote: All Gemini models other than Gemini 2.0 or Gemini 2.5 are billed based on modalities such as characters, images, video/audio seconds.
declined.reason: The page contradicts itself: its Gemini 3 and 4 model tables price "Input (text, image, video, audio)" under "Price (/1M tokens)", while this sentence says those models bill audio by seconds. A source that contradicts itself does not establish the unit.
